cases.title: Tidy labels says which pipe's label would move and by how many millimetres, and Esc moves nothing
cases.plan_item: Tidy labels names the pipe (gap plan section 3 item 7; BUG-856; regression C37; run 47 B.4.2)
cases.expected: With the switch on, CDTIDYLABELS with the answer All prints at least one preview line of the form 'pipe P<n> -> <name> ... would move <n> mm', so the drafter can see WHICH pipe's label is affected; the summary line begins '[CE] Will move'; it asks 'Move this label now? [Yes/No] <No>:' and one Esc prints '[CE] Nothing was moved.'; the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDTIDYLABELS cancelled'; the drawing holds the same number of objects afterwards.
cases.why_not_unit: The preview words come from the real labels, pipes and pits in the drawing and the live label-placement search; only the live command line shows them.
not_automated: The exact run-47 line 'pipe P8 -> open end start invert text would move 275 mm (further out)' needs the moved SPOT LEVEL block 10EC5D as an obstruction, which this case does not recreate; the figure is recorded, not asserted.
Apply with Yes and the U/REDO of the applied move (Codex W4-01 to W4-05) are not driven here.
